Project Overview

Building a Distinctive Luxury Accessories Identity

AURENZO is a luxury accessories brand based in Egypt, offering a diverse range of accessories for men and women. The project focused on building a distinctive visual identity from the ground up, creating a cohesive brand experience that communicates luxury, elegance, precision, and attention to detail.

The visual identity was developed to bring different accessory categories together under one coherent brand language, establishing a refined and recognizable foundation for the brand.

04 / 10

The Creative Concept

Time Meets Vision

THE CORE IDEA
The central logo concept merges two symbolic elements into one distinctive mark. The watch represents time, precision, and attention to detail, while the glasses represent vision, perspective, and personal style. Together, they translate AURENZO's personality into a recognizable visual symbol.

The concept connects the brand's product world with its overall personality, expressing the idea that personal style is shaped by both how we see the world and how we value every moment.

Visual Identity System

A Refined Black-and-Gold Visual Language

Color Palette

The visual language supports AURENZO's luxury positioning through a coordinated palette, typography, graphic elements, and patterns. Deep black and gold form the primary combination, supported by charcoal, warm gray, ivory, and muted bronze.

Gold#C9A24A
Deep Black#0D0D0D
Charcoal#1A1A1A
Warm Gray#2F2F2F
Soft Ivory#F5F2EA
Muted Bronze#8C6A3B

Typography & Graphic Elements

The typography combines Arabic and Latin typefaces, including Tajawal, Cairo, Cinzel, and Playfair Display, as presented in the identity exploration. Supporting graphic elements extend the brand language across print and digital touchpoints.

09 / 10

Social Media Direction

Exploring a Consistent Digital Brand Presence

DIGITAL COMMUNICATION

Content Direction

A collection of experimental post designs explores how AURENZO's visual identity can translate into social media communication. The concepts use product imagery, brand messaging, and a consistent black-and-gold visual language. These are exploratory designs, not published campaigns.

10 / 10

Final Brand Presentation

A Cohesive Identity Built Around Time and Vision

AURENZO's identity brings together the watch-and-glasses concept, a refined black-and-gold palette, bilingual typography, and supporting graphic elements to create a coherent visual foundation for a luxury accessories brand.

The project was approved by the client following revisions. Deliverables included the logo system, brand guidelines, website UI designs, and web banners. Website development and launch were not included; social media designs and brand application mockups are conceptual presentations.
